package config

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestEnumParsingAndStringValidation(t *testing.T) {
	mode, err := BuildOptionsModesString("fast")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, BuildOptionsModesFast, mode)
	_, err = BuildOptionsModesString("invalid")
	require.Error(t, err)
	opt := WithBuildOptions(WithModes([]string{mode.String(), BuildOptionsModesSafe.String()}))
	WithStates(func(yield func(string) bool) { yield(BuildOptionsStatesReady.String()) })(opt)
	require.NoError(t, opt.Validate())
	WithModes([]string{BuildOptionsModesFast.String(), "invalid"})(opt)
	require.Error(t, opt.Validate())
	WithModes([]string{BuildOptionsModesSafe.String()})(opt)
	WithStates(func(yield func(string) bool) { yield("invalid") })(opt)
	require.Error(t, opt.Validate())
}
